detail: Same department cannot overlap within the same section and track.
Different sections have independent baseline resources.
Different track lines are independent maintenance resources.
Cross-department overlap is allowed for identical windows when both allow co-location.
Heavy equipment is filtered against train occupancy on the other line.
Baseline does not prohibit heavy-equipment maintenance from overlapping maintenance on the adjacent line.
Both implementations use the baseline normalizer and reject a work order without duration_hrs.
